newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.

text.p: Mikuni and Co Ltd said on Friday it had assigned the following preliminary ratings to planned bond issues:
-AA-
Chubu Electric Power Co Inc, 150 billion yen mortgaged convertible due 2006.
The Gunma Bank Ltd, 50 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2001.
Hokuriku Electric Power Co, $300 million mortgaged due 2001.
-AA-
Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd,
30 billion yen mortgaged due 2001
30 billion yen mortgaged due 2006.
Sanwa Shutter Corp, 50 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2006.
The Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc,
300 million Swiss Francs mortgaged due 2006,
four billion France Francs mortgaged due 2006.
Toyoda Gosei Co Ltd, 20 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2004.
-BBB-
Yaizu Suisankagaku Industry Co Ltd, three billion yen unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement.
-BB-
Chubu Steel Plate Co Ltd, four billion yen unsecured convertible due 2001.
Maruzen Co Ltd, 20 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2005.
Mitsubishi Logistics Corp, 20 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2006.
Mitsubishi Materials Corp, 50 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2005.
Hokutetsu Paper Mills Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2002.
JDC Corp, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2002.
-CCC-
Diamond Lease Co Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2001.
